description: This file implements the DefaultAgentService in Go, providing methods to run, stop, and manage agent nodes, including process management, registry handling, environment setup, and capability display.

classes.name: DefaultAgentService
classes.description: Implements agent management functions including starting, stopping, and status checking of agents.

methods.name: RunAgent
methods.description: Starts an agent node, manages process creation, registry updates, and capability display.

methods.name: StopAgent
methods.description: Stops a running agent, attempting graceful shutdown via HTTP or process signals, and updates registry.

methods.name: GetAgentStatus
methods.description: Returns current status of an agent, including process and registry reconciliation.

methods.name: ListRunningAgents
methods.description: Lists all agents currently marked as running in the registry.

methods.name: loadRegistryDirect
methods.description: Loads the agent registry directly from YAML file.

methods.name: saveRegistryDirect
methods.description: Saves the agent registry directly to YAML file.

methods.name: convertToRunningAgent
methods.description: Converts registry package data to domain model for running agents.

methods.name: buildProcessConfig
methods.description: Creates process configuration including environment setup and virtual environment handling.

methods.name: waitForAgentNode
methods.description: Polls the agent's health endpoint until it is ready or timeout occurs.

methods.name: updateRuntimeInfo
methods.description: Updates registry with runtime info such as port, PID, and start time.

methods.name: displayCapabilities
methods.description: Fetches and displays agent's reasoners and skills via HTTP endpoints.

methods.name: findAgentInRegistry
methods.description: Finds an agent in the registry by name, handling normalization.

methods.name: loadPackageEnvFile
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a package's .env file.

methods.name: findPythonExecutable
methods.description: Attempts to locate a suitable Python interpreter executable.
